item.title: github: Public monitoring alerts now have direct links
item.description:
Public monitoring alerts in an enterprise’s Public monitoring view now support direct links to individual alerts. Clicking an alert number opens that alert directly.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Code scanning adds a mitigated alert dismissal reason
item.description:
Code scanning now supports dismissing alerts with the reason “Mitigated” when the vulnerability still exists in code but is offset by external controls, such as a web application firewall or network protections.

  • Source: GitHub
